patch_list: Allow screenshots & screen recording
Removes FLAG_SECURE and secure-surface flags from MUBI's players, so screenshots, screen recording and screen mirroring work. DRM-protected video may still render black on some devices.
Block analytics & tracking
No-ops Braze, Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook App Events and Segment logging in MUBI. Push notifications and account features keep working.
Block upgrade & sale deep links
Makes MUBI's upgrade screen non-exported and disables the upgrade-yearly / blackfriday / flash-sale deep links. Playback and entitlements are unchanged.
Bypass forced update
Neutralizes Play Core's update-availability checks so MUBI does not block startup on a newer version. Running an outdated build may break playback.
Change package name
Installs MUBI beside the official app by changing the package, permission names, provider authorities and launcher label. Play Billing, Cast and Google sign-in may not work on the clone.
Disable autoplay previews
Stops MUBI's home/browse screens from autoplaying muted trailers and previews. Opening a title still plays normally.
Enable picture-in-picture
Adds PiP support to MUBI's phone/tablet player: playback continues in a floating window when you press Home.
Force highest video quality

Reports a 1 Gbps connection to ExoPlayer/Media3 so MUBI picks the highest available rendition instead of downshifting. May increase data use and buffering on slow connections; server-side caps still apply.
Force TV (leanback) UI
Makes MUBI believe the device is a television, so Android TV boxes that misreport their form factor open the leanback UI. Do not enable on phones.
Packaging toolkit (signature, install source, MicroG)
Applies the shared signature, install-source and GmsCore/MicroG patches to MUBI in one step. Does not bypass Play Integrity or fix Play Billing.
Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
Removes MUBI's Custom Tabs service query so browser links can fall back to the normal external browser. No effect if MUBI launches Custom Tabs directly.
Remove promo cards & upsell banners
Disables Braze Content Cards, the Braze feed and card refreshes in MUBI. Push notifications and the app's own screens are untouched.
Skip pre-roll promos
Disables MUBI's app-side pre-roll gate when it is a boolean check. Pre-roll injected by the server or embedded in the stream is unaffected.
Skip TV confirmation dialog
Closes MUBI's Android TV confirmation screen before it draws. Only useful on TV devices; a flow waiting on a dialog result may stall.
Spoof Widevine level for MUBI
Reports L1 / HDCP 2.2 to MUBI's local DRM checks. Server-side licensing still decides the resolution, so HD may remain unavailable.
Suppress subscription paywall
Closes MUBI's upgrade screen immediately instead of showing it. Does not unlock playback or grant a subscription; only hides the upsell screen.
